page.content:
The Tribal Chief who held the Undisputed title through The Bloodline.

How Roman Reigns connects

  • Faction: The Bloodline — Roman Reigns leads The Bloodline as Tribal Chief.
  • Item: Undisputed WWE Championship — Roman Reigns unified and held the Undisputed WWE Championship.
  • Work: Friday Night SmackDown — The Bloodline's title era was centered on Friday Night SmackDown.

What is Roman Reigns?

Roman Reigns moved from The Shield into a long Tribal Chief reign, unifying the WWE and Universal titles and centering weekly TV on The Bloodline's family politics.

Key threads lead to The Bloodline, Undisputed WWE Championship and Friday Night SmackDown.
